stories.title: ‘Scary’: how misinformation and AI hallucinations are infiltrating Australia’s parliament
stories.summary: A Guardian analysis found that dozens of submissions to Australia’s parliament misrepresented genuine research or invented and incorrectly cited sources. The problems appeared across the political spectrum and included misinformation and apparent AI hallucinations.
